author: Blackie
text:
Live from the Grok Bot Kenya Workshop at @NodeNBO 🍕

The room was getting hungry, so I asked my @grok Bot to sort it out. It searched Glovo, worked out how much pizza we'd need, built the cart and got Pizza Inn on the way to Gigiri. All I did was approve the payment.

This is the kind of thing we're building today.

(P.S. this post was written by Grok Bot too, lol 🤖)
imageDescription: Glovo order tracking screen for the pizzas ordered during the workshop.
